probes.capture: knees been grumpy on the sunday long one again, outside edge mostly, totally fine midweek
probes.targetTitle: IT band flares past 10k, never on shorter efforts
probes.targetBody: knee playing up again on the long run, outside edge of it. only ever on the big ones, never the short midweek stuff
supportingTitles: Foam rolling before a run does nothing for me
New shoes take three runs before they stop pinching
Sunday long run is the only session I never skip
Calf tightness clears up after two rest days
probes.why: Not one content word is shared between the capture and the target, and the target is over a year old, so keyword and recency selectors both miss it.

probes.capture: up til 2am three nights straight, nothing different except it going dark at 5 now
probes.targetTitle: Sleep collapses the week after the clocks change
probes.targetBody: not slept right since the clocks went back. dark by teatime and my whole body reckons its two hours later than it is
supportingTitles: Reading in bed gets me under faster than any app
A late espresso costs me about an hour of sleep
Blackout blinds fixed the summer early waking
Winter mornings are the only ones I need an alarm for
probes.why: The pattern only recurs once a year, so the one note that explains it sits outside any recency window a cheap selector would use.

probes.capture: keep raiding the kitchen mid afternoon, always the days i just have coffee til lunch
probes.targetTitle: Skipping breakfast makes me snack badly by 4pm
probes.targetBody: in the biscuits by four again. only had coffee this morning. every time i skip the first thing i end up eating rubbish later on
supportingTitles: Cooking on Sunday is what keeps the week honest
Eating out twice a week is the sustainable number
Coffee on an empty stomach makes me jittery not alert
Protein at lunch keeps the 3pm slump smaller
probes.why: The capture says raiding the kitchen and the target says snack, so token overlap is essentially zero despite them being the same observation.

probes.capture: everything felt grey and pointless again, then realised i havent been outside the door since thursday
probes.targetTitle: Two days without leaving the flat tanks my mood
probes.targetBody: felt flat and horrible all weekend then clocked i hadnt been out the front door since friday. two days in and im a different person
supportingTitles: Morning light does more for me than the vitamin D pills
Working from the cafe is worth the worse chair
Cancelling plans feels great and then it doesn't
Rain days are when the slump actually starts
probes.why: The capture never names mood or the flat, and the one word it shares with nearby notes is outside, which points at the wrong cluster.

probes.capture: brain like soup til about 11 every day this week, oh right the hayfever tablets started back up
probes.targetTitle: Antihistamines leave me foggy until mid morning
probes.targetBody: head full of cotton wool til about 11 every day. started the hayfever tablets monday. same thing every year and i forget every year
supportingTitles: Pollen season starts a fortnight earlier than I expect
The nasal spray works but I always forget it
Two coffees does not cancel out a bad night
Afternoon focus is better than morning focus lately
probes.why: The target is exactly one allergy season old, so it falls off a recency shortlist in the very week it becomes relevant again.

probes.capture: dead at 3 again. had a proper lunch so its not that. pint of water and twenty mins later im fine
probes.targetTitle: Afternoon crash is dehydration, not low blood sugar
probes.targetBody: wiped out at 3 again. had a big lunch so its not that. drank a pint of water and twenty minutes later i was fine. i just dont drink anything all day
supportingTitles: A big lunch is not what makes me sleepy after all
The desk bottle only gets refilled if it's in view
Walking after eating helps more than caffeine does
Meetings back to back are when I forget to drink
probes.why: The capture describes the mechanism in body language and never uses dehydration or blood sugar, so keyword scoring ranks unrelated lunch notes higher.

probes.capture: third quality day this week and my legs were rubbish the whole way, felt like wading through it
probes.targetTitle: Three hard sessions a week is one too many
probes.targetBody: did three hard ones this week and by the last my legs were dead. two and i feel great, three and the whole thing falls apart
supportingTitles: Easy days have to actually be easy or nothing works
Racing well needs a down week ten days out
Hill reps are the session I dread and need most
Two hard days plus a long run is the sustainable shape
probes.why: The lesson was learned in a previous training block over a year ago and is being relearned now, so recency selectors surface only this block's notes.

probes.capture: guts in bits again after the thai place last night and i didnt even touch the bread this time
probes.targetTitle: Onions, not gluten, are what wreck my stomach
probes.targetBody: stomach in bits again. had no bread all week so its not that. the only thing all the bad days have in common is a load of onion
supportingTitles: Cutting bread for a month changed nothing at all
Restaurant food is the only reliable trigger
Dairy is fine in coffee and not fine in a bowl
Keeping a food note for a week beats guessing
probes.why: The capture rules out the wrong culprit by name, which pulls keyword selectors toward the gluten notes and away from the one that names onions.

probes.capture: arms all angry and itchy again, and its been a weirdly calm week so thats not the usual excuse
probes.targetTitle: Eczema flares track laundry detergent, not stress
probes.targetBody: arms all angry again. works been quiet so the stress thing doesnt hold up. only thing thats changed is we ran out and used the other washing powder
supportingTitles: The thick ointment works, I just stop using it early
Hot showers make the itching worse within an hour
Deadline weeks are when everything else falls apart
New bedding week is worth writing down
probes.why: Angry and itchy arms shares no vocabulary with eczema, and the capture's only strong token, calm week, points at the stress notes the target explicitly rejects.

probes.capture: legs were shot so i binned the session and just walked the block, and the pricing page thing untangled itself on the way round
probes.targetTitle: Design blocks break on a walk, not at the desk
probes.targetBody: sat staring at that layout for two hours and got nowhere. went round the block and had it sorted before i got back in. never happens at the desk
supportingTitles: Rest days are when the training actually lands
Pricing page has been stuck for three weeks now
The best ideas arrive when I'm not at a keyboard
Skipping a session guilt free is a skill I lack
probes.why: The capture is filed as a body note but the note it belongs with lives in the work domain, so any selector that clusters or quotas by domain drops the bridge.

probes.capture: odd metallic taste in my mouth the last two mornings, never had this before, nothing new that i can think of
supportingTitles: Antihistamines leave me foggy until mid morning
Onions, not gluten, are what wreck my stomach
Dentist says the grinding is stress and not the bite
Sleep collapses the week after the clocks change
probes.why: Nothing in the vault explains this, so the correct behaviour is no link; the surrounding health notes are close enough in domain that a selector will happily hand the model a plausible wrong one.

probes.capture: shoulder is grumbling again, same side, same as when the pool was shut over christmas
probes.targetTitle: Shoulder ache follows weeks with no swimming
probes.targetBody: shoulders been aching all week. havent been in the pool since it shut, thats the only thing different. always the same side
supportingTitles: The pool closure in December broke a two year streak
Desk posture is worse on days with no gym
Physio exercises only get done if they live by the kettle
Swimming is the only cardio my knees never object to
probes.why: The target atom does not exist at the start of the catch-up run; it is filed from a much earlier daily in the same run, so a frozen title prefix makes the link structurally impossible.

probes.capture: the thing that actually broke this quarter wasnt anyone being slow. it was three fast people with no judgement shipping confidently. i had this the wrong way round
probes.targetTitle: Hiring for raw speed beats hiring for taste
probes.targetBody: the ones who just get stuff out are worth more than the careful ones. you can tidy it up after, you cant teach someone to move
supportingTitles: Interviews measure how well people interview
A slow hire is cheaper than a fast mistake
Taste is the thing you cannot train in a quarter
Velocity is a team property and not a person one
probes.why: The capture overturns the old belief rather than restating it, so unless that exact atom is in the shortlist the run files a contradictory duplicate instead of a supersession.

probes.capture: did the maths properly this time with maintenance and the interest and staying put is cheaper for another five years at least. mildly annoyed at past me
probes.targetTitle: Renting is money thrown away versus owning
probes.targetBody: handed over another months rent for nothing. at least with a mortgage some of it stays yours, this just goes
supportingTitles: A deposit is the only savings goal I have ever kept
Owning means every weekend has a job attached
Rent going up every year is the argument I keep making
Mortgage rates changed the whole calculation this year
probes.why: The superseded belief is nearly two years old and the capture uses spreadsheet language rather than the belief's moral framing, so it fails both the recency and the keyword route at once.

probes.capture: the meltdown wasnt the ipad, theyd been up since five. tired is the whole story and i keep pinning it on the screen because thats easier
probes.targetTitle: Screen time is the main thing to control
probes.targetBody: another meltdown when the ipad went off. if i get the screen stuff under control i reckon most of the bad evenings sort themselves out
supportingTitles: Bedtime slips by ten minutes a night if nobody watches
Saying no to the tablet costs more than it saves
Weekend routine falls apart and Monday pays for it
Nursery days end in tears more often than home days
probes.why: Supersession of a parenting belief where the capture's strongest token, screen, matches the old atom's surface but the reasoning inverts it; a selector that finds it by keyword can still be beaten by this month's dozens of bedtime notes.

probes.capture: spent an hour poking round the fediverse thing and every single server has one exhausted volunteer doing the same job badly. moving the servers about doesnt move the work
probes.targetTitle: Decentralised networks solve moderation problems
probes.targetBody: the whole problem is one company deciding what everyone gets to see. spread the servers out so nobody holds that switch and it sorts itself
supportingTitles: Platform rules are labour policy wearing a product costume
Nobody wants to be the one who decides what stays up
Small communities self police until they get big
Account portability is a real win and the only one
probes.why: The overturned belief is nearly a year old and the capture argues from a concrete observation without naming decentralisation or moderation, so the contradiction is invisible to both cheap selectors.

probes.capture: the outline thing again. two days on structure and the writing came out stiff as anything, same as last time and the time before
probes.targetTitle: First drafts get worse the more I plan them
probes.targetBody: planned the whole piece out properly and it came out dead on the page. the ones i just started and worked out as i went read miles better
supportingTitles: Writing in the morning is worth being worse at everything else
Editing is where the thinking actually happens
Deadlines produce prose that planning never does
Notes on index cards beat notes in an app for me
probes.why: A thread the person has picked up every few months for over a year; the capture assumes the reader remembers it, so the referent again carries all the meaning and none of the searchable words.

probes.capture: the funeral thing keeps coming back to me. nobody stood up in that room and cared what he built at work, not one person
probes.targetTitle: Being known by five people beats being known widely
probes.targetBody: nobody in that room mentioned his job once. it was all the small stuff and the handful of people who actually sat with him. thats the bit that counts
supportingTitles: Ambition without a deadline is just anxiety
Legacy is a word people use to avoid saying scared
I check the follower count more than I would admit
Old friendships need booking and new ones just happen
probes.why: A recurring reflection revisited over almost a year in different words each time, and its target has no vocabulary in common with the funeral framing of this instance.

probes.capture: cut back to two newsletters and i can suddenly hold an argument again. its the pruning doing it not the reading
probes.targetTitle: Reading fewer sources made my opinions sharper
probes.targetBody: unsubscribed from nearly all of it and weirdly i can hold a view again. was taking in loads and thinking less and less
supportingTitles: The house move has eaten every spare thought for a month
Survey day was worse than the offer day
Packing is an inventory of decisions I avoided
Solicitor emails arrive in threes and say nothing
Second viewing changed my mind about the kitchen
Removals quotes vary by a factor of three
Mortgage paperwork took four evenings this week

probes.capture: told them it was fine when it really wasnt and now im keeping two versions of the story straight in my head. exhausting

probes.targetBody: said it was fine to save the awkwardness and now i cant look at her straight. its not even a big lie but somethings gone off between us
supportingTitles: Reorg rumours are worse than the reorg
Standup has become a status report nobody reads
The new manager asks good questions and acts on none
Three months of firefighting and no roadmap moved
Every one to one this quarter has been about headcount
Working late is a habit and not a workload

probes.capture: still telling people im going to write the book someday. its been someday for two years and it just sits there making me twitchy
probes.targetTitle: Ambition without a deadline is just anxiety
probes.targetBody: keep saying ill do it someday. someday isnt a plan, its just a thing sat at the back of my head making me feel bad
supportingTitles: Wanting a thing is not the same as choosing it
The projects I finished all had someone waiting
Saying a goal out loud makes it harder to drop quietly
Half-started ideas cost more attention than they look like

probes.capture: the junior got twice as much done the week i stopped doing the daily check in. exactly the same as the piano practice thing at home
probes.targetTitle: Kids learn faster when nobody is watching them
probes.targetBody: left her to the piano and didnt hover for once and she got more done in an hour than the whole month of me sat there correcting her

Delegating badly is just supervising with extra steps
Standups make juniors perform progress not make it
Praise for effort lands better than praise for results

probes.capture: walked out of that room and not one of us could say what we agreed. everyone nodding at everything is how nothing ends up owned
probes.targetTitle: Consensus decisions are nobody's decisions
probes.targetBody: everyone agreed and then nothing happened. when the whole room says yes theres nobody actually on the hook for it
supportingTitles: A meeting without a named owner is a status update
Disagreement in the room is cheaper than in the build
Writing the decision down is most of deciding it
Big meetings make small decisions and vice versa

supportingTitles: First drafts get worse the more I plan them
Editing is where the thinking actually happens
Writing is how I find out what I think
Tools change the work and then change the standard
